get_property_from_atoms: retrieve a property value from an ASE Atoms object by name from its properties or info dictionary
normalize_property_by_natoms: normalize a property value by dividing it by the number of atoms in an ASE Atoms object
normalize_property_by_other: normalize a property value by dividing it by another property value from an ASE Atoms object
get_property_dict_from_atoms: extract multiple properties from an ASE Atoms object into a dictionary with optional normalization per property
get_property_dict_with_per_atom: extract properties from an ASE Atoms object and include per-atom normalized versions in the returned dictionary
